component.name: Clocks
component.summary: A clocks application for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: Clocks brings every kind of timekeeping into one application built for the COSMIC desktop. A background service owns the schedule, so alarms ring, timers finish and pomodoro sessions advance whether or not a window is open, and their notifications reopen the app on the page you need.

ul.li: World clocks, with sunrise and sunset for each city
Alarms that repeat, snooze and ring with the app closed
A stopwatch with lap timing and saved history
Countdown timers that repeat a set number of times
Pomodoro sessions with focus mode and daily statistics
A countdown to dated events, with reminders beforehand
Workout timers built from composable prepare, work and rest blocks
A chess clock with configurable time controls and increments

description.p: The sidebar can be reordered and pages hidden, so the app shows only the clocks you actually use.

screenshot.caption: Alarms that ring with the app closed
A chess clock with configurable time controls

ul.li: Alarms, timers, pomodoro and event countdowns run in a background service and fire with the app closed
World clocks, stopwatch, workout timer and chess clock
A reorderable, hideable sidebar and a quick-action palette
